name: kinesiolive-monorepo
description: KinesioLive - Real-Time Biomechanical Telemetry & Telerehabilitation Monorepo

scripts.check:hygiene: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); const s=path.resolve('client/src'); const bad=fs.existsSync(s)?fs.readdirSync(s).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')||f.endsWith('.d.ts')):[]; if(bad.length){console.error('Dirty build artifacts found in client/src:', bad); process.exit(1);} else {console.log('[OK] client/src is clean of compiled artifacts');}"
